synopsis.text: Sonic the Hedgehog 3 is the third in the Sonic series of games. As with the previous games, it is a side-scrolling platformer based around speed. The basic game remains the same - players collect rings to earn extra lives, which are also used for protection, and scatter everywhere when Sonic is hurt. Sonic can jump on enemies to defeat them, and Spin Dash by holding down and the jump button, then letting go of down. Dr. Robotnik's Death Egg has crash-landed on Floating Island, so called because it harnesses the power of the Chaos Emeralds to float in the air. Robotnik needs them to repair the Death Egg, so he tells the guardian of Floating Island, Knuckles the Echidna, that Sonic and Tails are there to steal them. With Knuckles tricked and trying to stop the heroes at every turn, will they be able to stop Robotnik in time? New to Sonic 3 are three different types of shields; the Fire Shield (which protects you from fire but disappears if you enter water), the Water Shield (which lets you breathe underwater infinitely), and the Electric Shield (which pulls nearby rings towards you).

Attention, Sonic revient.

Cuando llegan a la Angel Island, Knuckels, el guardián de la isla, ataca Sonic y roba las Esmeraldas del Caos. Como resultado, el Dr. Robotnik, por accidente, desembarca en la isla después de que su Death Egg fuera destruida. Él ha convencido a Knuckels de que Sonic es el malo y debe ser detenido. Sonic y Tails deben detener a Robotnik y convencer a Knuckels.

Sei grandi livelli. Scene speciali completamente nuove. Nuovi
nemici nella più grande avventura di Sonic!

O Death Egg do Dr. Robotnik aterrissou na Angel Island, também conhecida como Ilha Flutuante porque aproveita o poder da Master Emerald para flutuar no ar. Robotnik precisa dela para reparar o Death Egg, então ele diz ao guardião da ilha, Knuckles the Echidna que Sonic e Tails estão lá para roubá-la. Com Knuckles enganado e tentando parar os heróis, eles serão capazes de impedir Robotnik a tempo?

This is a hack of Sonic the Hedgehog 3 for the Sega Genesis. It changes the frequency of music and sound effects making for a different sounding game. Some music is barely recognizable and the game can feel quite different because of it.

The patch is in xdelta format. The ROM should be in BIN format.
